planning_scope: One or two notes, already captured native inputs and initialized private engine; includes bounded metadata scan. Excludes input preparation and cold initialization.
source_id_scope: Per-fixture, process-local identities of loaded material objects; never persist pointers or compare numeric IDs across processes. Catalog contains metadata, not source audio.
identity_comparison: Ordered runs of material identity, phoneme IDs, stage, direction, bank and unit; consecutive repetitions of the same stationary material are collapsed.
scope_limit: No alternate ART recording was selected by duration alone in these fixtures. Sustained material insertion is proven. Synthetic budget tests demonstrate the conditional ability to choose another material, not universal availability in installed banks. Editor runtime and an independent selection-duration control remain unverified.
